problem_context.problem_statement: 重新验证 CRTOS CircularAreaWrite，使其与 Init 返回的 UCharArray::mixed_full backing resource 可直接组合。不得修改任何可执行 C 代码，只允许修改 annotation、case_lib 和生成/证明产物；EOK=0、ERROR=1，成功写入应按 FIFO/ring 语义更新逻辑内容和 mixed physical buffer。完成 canonical symbolic execution、全部 manual VC、fixed goal_check、final-check 与独立 freshness。
problem_context.expected_behavior: NULL、无空间或非法输入返回 ERROR(1)并保持资源；成功返回 EOK(0)，把请求字节按 ring 写入，更新 writeidx/b_status/逻辑 FIFO 内容，保留完整 mixed backing ownership。
problem_context.input_output_contract: 输入为 descriptor 的 CircularAreaBackingResource/mixed_full、完整 initialized input_buffer 与 GlobalStrings；输出保持可供 Read/DataLength/Release/再次 Write 消费的同一 canonical resource，成功分支逻辑内容追加 input prefix。
spec_hint: 复用 shared callpoint specs 的 CircularAreaBackingResource、CircularAreaLogicalState、CircularAreaLiveBytes；memcpy 写目的片段可从 mixed_seg 转换为 initialized seg，最后重组 mixed_full。
preferred_hidden_properties: 写入后 physical option-list 只在目标 ring slices 变为 Some input byte，其余位置保持；logical FIFO=old logical ++ written prefix。
forbidden_patterns: 不得修改函数体、宏语义、函数签名或可执行 token；不得用 full 假设替代 mixed_full；不得读取 QCP_demos_human；不得使用 forbidden lemma。

annotation_contract.ready_condition: agent_result.annotation.status == completed and ready_for_annotation_check_round == true only after canonical QCP, case_lib coqc, and annotation-checking pass; self_reworkable_failures must be empty
annotation_contract.blocked_condition: only phase skill hard blockers should use status == blocked; self_repair_budget_exhausted is work evidence, not an automatic blocked condition

avoid_spec_antipatterns: Do not weaken the spec to shape-only or bounds-only conditions.
Do not restate the C loops as the mathematical definition.
